claim_updates.reason: Fix3 redesign validated narrowly: _is_protocol_only_prefix correctly rejects bare authority ('https://api.example.com', 'http://localhost:8080', 'https://a.com') and accepts query-parameterized ('https://api.example.com?key=', etc.) and path-slash prefixes for 12/12 corpus, preserves kernel regression 3/3, distills single-slot GET mechanism comments?postId=${url} with slot [url] that resolves EXECUTABLE and binds to https://jsonplaceholder.typicode.com/comments?postId=5 with 3/3 HTTP 200 on jsonplaceholder. This fixes parent V2_FIX3_OVERBROAD for host?query patterns. However, Fix3 independent necessity over Fix2 not demonstrated (audit V1): Fix2 and Fix3 are mutually exclusive for all non-trivial prefixes (bare authority: Fix2 False Fix3 True; valid params: Fix2 True Fix3 False); only scheme-only 'https://' discriminant untested. Claim ceiling bounded to 'single-slot GET with host?query or path-slash on jsonplaceholder deterministic synthetic data, n=3 HTTP verification'. Does NOT support multi-slot, PUT/POST, noisy browser, LLM distillation, cross-site, or product economics. C-PRODUCT-ECON remains HYPOTHESIS.
